design.comparison: Same parent vs fixed nc1 compilation;no plan sweep
design.cohorts: Two fixed synthetic cohorts and normal/coherent distributions per family;two reversed arm orders,25measurements per arm
design.replication: Graph measurements are repeated samples within one job,not independent jobs
design.numerics: Exact output/entirecache bytes and parent-repeat controls;3changinginputs per12configurations;no tolerance relaxation
design.publication: No automatic score;real selected new-path profile and material weighted-load/control evidence required

stop: Any resource/byte/control/budget/performance failure disables family. Empty choices or fallback-only point is not a gain. No noise retry or Decode transfer.
